scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Describes the proportion of blood volume occupied by red cells.
high: Dehydration or increased red-cell production can raise the proportion.
low: Blood loss, anemia or pregnancy-related fluid changes can lower the proportion.
caveats: Age, sex, altitude and hydration affect interpretation. Do not infer a particular disorder from the percentage alone.
